mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS does not decline sufficiently over the 20-day horizon or S&P 500 returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the CPIAUCSL index above 240 signals accelerating inflation, prompting market anticipation of tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL does not cross 240 or returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent weakening of the federal funds rate below 0.1% and robust growth in GDP demand (GDPC1) creates a dual expansion signal, amplifying equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 0.1% and GDPC1 growth > 5% in next month
failure_condition: If the combined effect of FEDFUNDS and GDPC1 does not lead to positive returns or the trigger conditions are not met.

mechanism_narrative: Improving labor market conditions, marked by rising unemployment rates and expanding job growth (UNRATE up >0.2% and PAYEMS growth >5%), signal labor market recovery and positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.2% and PAYEMS growth > 5% in next month
failure_condition: If the labor indicators do not meet the trigger or returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Strong concurrent demand signals from HOUST (industrial production) and RSAFS (retail sales) both rising >10% in the next month indicate robust economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both HOUST and RSAFS rise >10% in next month
failure_condition: If either HOUST or RSAFS does not meet the threshold or returns are not positive over 60 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in INDPRO above 108 signals robust supply-side expansion, fostering economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO crosses above 108 in next month
failure_condition: If INDPRO does not cross 108 or returns are not positive in the 5-day window.

mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rates (<0.1%) coupled with rising unemployment rates (UNRATE >0.3%) create a dual expansion signal, enhancing equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 0.1% and UNRATE rises > 0.3% in next month
failure_condition: If the combined monetary and labor indicators do not trigger the conditions or returns are not positive over 60 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the federal funds rate above 1.5% during a late-cycle expansion signals restrictive monetary policy, prompting market anticipation of economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 1.5% in next month
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS does not cross 1.5% or returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05).
